jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or technical consulting, owning technical evaluations that decided real deals Genuine hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure and data platforms, including AWS and Databricks plus Spark and Kubernetes (or adjacent technologies) Ability to translate complex architecture into outcomes for senior engineers and executives

jobs.title: Devops Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 6+ years in DevOps, Platform, or Infrastructure Engineering with ownership of production environments for a real product at scale Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, with GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent) as the default way to ship Strong production experience on AWS (EKS, IAM, VPC networking) plus managed services such as Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, or Kinesis; scripting in Python, Go, or Bash
